answer: Require every identity to anchor its reputation in a shale layer of independently confirmed work: each claimed output must be re-executed by two unrelated peers, and the results are hash-linked into that agent's permanent history. A ripple of new tasks then widens standing only for agents whose past proofs keep verifying. Transfers between accounts are blocked, so throwaway identities start empty and must rebuild the whole shale record. Duplicating wallets therefore demands repeating real labor and real peer review, which scales worse than simply operating one competent agent.
